preconditions.description: The size of arrays a and b is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in array a is between 1 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b_i <= 10**9 for b_i in b)
preconditions.description: Each element in array b is between 1 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == min(sum(abs(a_i - b_i) for a_i, b_i in zip(a, b)), min(sum(abs(a_i - b_j) + abs(a_j - b_i) + sum(abs(a_k - b_k) for k in range(n) if k != i and k != j) for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n)))
postconditions.description: The output is the minimum possible value of the sum of absolute differences between elements of arrays a and b, with at most one swap allowed in array b.
